text_to_image_prompt: Photorealistic complete hollow outfit, no person, skin or visible mannequin, pure white seamless background, soft studio light, portrait 2:3, fully uncropped. Garments: Cream boxy button jacket, blue-brown checked shirt, dark bootcut jeans, brown heels.. Add ONLY these accessories: 黑色大墨镜; 棕色皮腰带; 深色手拿包; 金色长圆章项链; 金色手链. No additional accessories or props.
original_prompt: Create ONE photorealistic complete outfit catalog composition on pure white seamless background, soft studio light, portrait 2:3. Input 1 is the APPROVED garment ensemble: preserve exactly its silhouette, textile, colors, layers, footwear and hosiery. Do not redesign or add clothes. Input 2 contains the FIRST FOUR listed accessories as a technical reference board. Remaining inputs contain one remaining accessory each in list order. Recompose all into one outfit, do NOT reproduce board panels. Use every listed component once (earrings/gloves as a pair). Garments: Cream boxy button jacket, blue-brown checked shirt, dark bootcut jeans, brown heels. Accessories: Accessory: 黑色大墨镜; Accessory: 棕色皮腰带; Accessory: 深色手拿包; Accessory: 金色长圆章项链; Accessory: 金色手链. Keep the garment ensemble dominant and full length. Attach belts, ties and brooches naturally; place hats, bags, eyewear, jewelry and hand props neatly adjacent at realistic scale with clear separation, not overlapping important garment details. Where clothing is shown in flat lay, keep the coordinated flat lay; empty hosiery must stay separately laid flat. No person, skin, face, head, hands, legs, feet, anatomy, visible mannequin, stand or hanger. Transparent cloth reveals WHITE, never skin. Shoes and sleeves empty. No extra hats, bags, glasses, belts, jewelry or footwear beyond the input assets. No duplicates, no panels or inset images, no text/watermarks. Fully uncropped with white margins. This is an object-only wardrobe asset.
reproduction_note: 根据服装参考生成无人商品展示。遮挡或未展示的细节采用保守补全；文字和品牌细节仅为视觉参考。未进行逐图重新生成相似度验证。
